metadata.description: Four federal acquisition and GovCon workflow plugins

plugins.name: pre-award-agent
plugins.description: Build a SOW or PWS and carry its approved scope into the correctly routed IGCE.

plugins.name: other-transaction-agent
plugins.description: Build an OT project description and carry its approved milestones into cost analysis.

plugins.name: govcon-growth-agent
plugins.description: Find, evaluate, and research federal growth opportunities with evidence-backed capture intelligence.

plugins.name: market-research-agent
plugins.description: Conduct acquisition market research from supplied documents, federal data, and approved evidence plans.
